names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 aprilie, «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 28. април ст. ст., „Св. муч. Максим, Дада и Квинтилијан.“ Св. муч. stands over all three names and муч. is the `martyr` this folder already carries in `types`; the heading gives no epithet and no village — Ozovia is the Romanian life's — so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form. Several folders already hold it; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 aprilie — «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the three no years: it sets them only in the reigns of «Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.) και Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)» and under «τῶν ὑπάτων Γαβιβίου και Ταρκυΐνου», so no `dates` were taken. **The Greek keeps the three a fortnight before the Romanian**, which prints them on 28 aprilie; both pages are the same company — the three readers of the Church from Ozovia, beheaded together — and the Greek adds their office, the consuls' names, and the resting place of the relics at Constantinople, in the church of the Most Holy Mother of God «ἐν τοὶς Βιγλεντίου», where their synaxis was kept. The page prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.05.2026 (28. април ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Максим, Дада и Квинтилијан.“

attestations.note: An **enumerated heading** of three, so three rows and no company note needed. The whole entry is three short sentences and it adds almost nothing to what this folder already holds: they suffered in the time of Diocletian, were judged and tortured by **the voivode Tarquinius**, and after prison and torments were beheaded with the sword. The two things worth recording are that **this book keeps the three on 28 April with the Romanian calendar and against the Greek 13 April**, and that **„у време Диоклецијана“ is a reign with no printed bounds** and was therefore not turned into a date: this folder stays undated, as doxologia's long life and saint.gr's notice both left it. The Prologue prints no hymn.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia», Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their striving won from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength, they overthrew their tormentors and shattered the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.
